title: Cold rebuild: the scoring matrix
summary: Rebuild the weighted ranking with knock-outs from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **Rank** in *RabbitMQ vs Kafka, honestly*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed the first
Why: in a design review you will be asked to rerun the matrix with someone else's weights, live. Being able to
rebuild it is how you know you understand what it does and does not prove.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.explain: `GetValueOrDefault` turns a missing criterion into 0: it adds nothing to the score and fails any minimum above 0.

steps.title: Rebuild Rank cold
prompt: Write `List<string> Rank(Dictionary<string, int> weights, Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, int>> scores, Dictionary<string, int> minimums)`:
- score = sum over `weights` of `weight * score` (a missing criterion counts as 0);
- an option is excluded when any criterion in `minimums` scores below its minimum (missing = 0); report the first
failing criterion in ordinal alphabetical order;
- return `"{name} {score}"` lines, highest first, ties by name (ordinal), then
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty.
List<string> Rank(Dictionary<string, int> weights, Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, int>> scores, Dictionary<string, int> minimums)
